source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that supported mutable Driver Health settings persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default without losing UEFI/OS drivers or their boot, storage, network, console and management devices.
original_method: Identify in-scope firmware Driver Health entries, change supported controls, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while collecting driver/device/boot and health evidence.
manual_activity: A human must navigate Driver Health, distinguish settings from status/actions, perform only approved firmware changes and both reboot/default phases, and inspect results. Automated device/driver inventory is supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Driver Health entry, provider/version and associated device map
Entry type: mutable, status-only or repair/action
Approved baseline, non-default and SPEC-default values for mutable controls
Console/operator, recovery media and BMC/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or invoke an unidentified repair/action entry as if it were a setting.
Do not disable or reconfigure critical boot, storage, network or console drivers without exact recovery.
Do not substitute OS driver installation/removal for firmware Driver Health behavior.
Stop on device/driver loss, repair prompt, hang, boot or management failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only firmware/OS driver, PCI/device, boot, log and BMC health evidence.
Correlate operator captures with exact provider/device identity.
Do not drive BIOS, invoke repair actions, install/remove drivers or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Classify page entries and approve mutable fields/defaults, critical-device map and recovery.
Evaluate firmware and driver/device evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS driver inventory is read-only support and may not represent the firmware driver object under test.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the exact firmware Driver Health page and add approved read-only provider/device/boot evidence; do not use OS driver changes or generic device presence as substitutes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source text but does not authorize status/action invocation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Inventory each page entry as setting, status or action; for approved mutable entries map provider/version/device, values/defaults and critical-path effect, then capture firmware and read-only device/driver state through all phases.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact firmware driver-health implementation and installed devices/OS.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/firmware, driver provider/version, device firmware, OS and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Driver Health page semantics and vendor driver/device documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents status or repair actions from being treated as arbitrary settings and adds exact provider/device identity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; mutable controls receive lifecycle coverage and status/actions receive appropriate observation/disposition without unauthorized activation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Entry types, provider/device map, defaults and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS driver health is not necessarily the same as UEFI driver health; evidence must label the layer.

project_override_considerations: The project selects supported mutable entries and may separately authorize a repair-action test. Results apply only to named firmware entries and must not claim all OS drivers.
expected_evidence: Identity, entry-type/provider/device map, approval and recovery
First save/reboot persistence plus exact driver/device evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and critical-path health
Final driver-health state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source lifecycle is coherent for mutable controls. The title may include status/actions, but the platform page inventory can define applicability without an opposing source requirement.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended firmware lifecycle is identifiable. Entry types, values and recovery gate execution but do not permanently block the generic case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual classification and adds layer/entry/device specificity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains useful driver/device evidence and recovery but rejects PARTIAL based solely on supporting automation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores MANUAL ONLY and prevents repair/status entries from being mutated generically.

review_improvement: Prevents firmware driver-health objects from being conflated with OS drivers or arbitrary repair actions and protects critical device paths.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core firmware navigation, entry interpretation and visual state acceptance are human tasks, so MANUAL ONLY applies. Read-only driver/device evidence cannot automate them.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat firmware changes, repair actions, reboot or default load after driver/device/boot anomalies; preserve the first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
